national_news.title: India's retail inflation rises to 4.45%, remains above RBI's target of 4%
bullets: Retail inflation accelerated to 4.45% on an annual basis in July.
Inflation remained above the Reserve Bank of India's target of 4% for the second consecutive month.
Food prices remained elevated, contributing to the moderate increase in inflation.

national_news.title: Indian Grandmaster R Praggnanandhaa defeats Javokhir Sindarov in Sinquefield Cup
bullets: Indian Grandmaster R Praggnanandhaa secured his first victory in the Sinquefield Cup.
The match was a part of the Grand Chess Tour, with the Sinquefield Cup being the penultimate event.
Praggnanandhaa dominated the game from start to finish, eventually turning the endgame in his favor.

national_news.title: Sports Ministry suspends TTFI's recognition till restoration of its governance structure
bullets: Sports Ministry suspended TTFI's recognition due to governance deficiencies.
TTFI failed to conduct elections on time, prompting the Ministry's action.
IOA to form an ad-hoc committee to administer the sport in consultation with ITTF.

national_news.title: India wins 3 gold, 1 silver, and 1 bronze in Commonwealth Fencing Championship
bullets: India won 3 gold, 1 silver, and 1 bronze medal in the Commonwealth Fencing Championship.
The championship was held in Lagos, Nigeria.
India's overall combined medal count reached 29, comprising 8 Gold, 7 Silver, and 14 Bronze.

national_news.title: Canadian Open Tennis: Men’s and women’s semifinals locked in
bullets: Iga Swiatek of Poland will face Elina Svitolina of Ukraine in the women's singles semifinals.
Elena Rybakina will meet Coco Gauff in the other women's singles semifinal.
The semifinals will take place in Toronto tomorrow morning.

national_news.title: Thailand's Education Ministry to elevate school safety after mass shooting
bullets: Thailand's cabinet has approved an Education Ministry's proposal to elevate school safety to a national agenda.
The move aims to strengthen prevention and response at educational institutions systematically, protecting children, teachers, and education personnel nationwide.
All schools have been designated School Safety Zones and must set up centres for the protection of rights, liberties, and safety on their premises.

national_news.title: DoT selects three Sanchar Mitras as envoys of ITU
bullets: The Department of Telecommunications has selected three Sanchar Mitras from India as Generation Connect Youth Envoys (GCYE) of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU).

The programme provides young people with opportunities to contribute to national, regional and global discussions and initiatives related to Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs), digital transformation and inclusive digital development.
The initiative aligns closely with the objectives of the Sanchar Mitra Scheme, which seeks to engage youth in promoting digital literacy and inclusion.

national_news.title: BRICS economies are major growth engines of global economy: FM Sitharaman
bullets: BRICS economies are among the major engines of global growth.
Public capital should act as a catalyst for private investment, not a substitute.
Maintaining stability and providing a predictable environment is crucial for attracting private capital.

national_news.title: Lok Sabha refers FCRA Bill to JPC for further scrutiny
bullets: The Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026, aims to make the use of foreign contributions more transparent and accountable.
The Bill was referred to the Joint Parliamentary Committee (JPC) for wider consultations.
The JPC will consist of 21 members from the Lok Sabha, nominated by the Speaker.

national_news.title: Parliament passes Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026 to change state name to Keralam
bullets: The Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026, was passed by the Lok Sabha yesterday and the Rajya Sabha today.
The Bill seeks to change the name of the state of Kerala to Keralam in the First Schedule of the Constitution.
The Kerala Legislative Assembly had passed a resolution in 2024, requesting the Centre to change the name of the State from Kerala to Keralam.

national_news.title: Parliament passes bill to enhance funding and development of cooperative sector
bullets: The National Co-operative Development Corporation (NCDC) (Amendment) Bill, 2026 has been passed by Parliament.
The Bill aims to further amend the National Co-operative Development Corporation Act, 1962.
The legislation allows the Corporation to undertake activities in industrial goods and provides funding to entities engaged in co-operative development.

national_news.title: Union Agriculture Minister Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan launches National Scholarship Portal
bullets: Scholarships worth Rs 21.35 crore released to over 6,000 agriculture students through NSP-DBT
Union Minister stresses on practical training, timely assistance and agricultural innovation
Scholarship portal aims to provide timely assistance to agriculture students

national_news.title: The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (Amendment) Bill, 2026
bullets: The Bill updates the existing MSMED Act, 2006 to align its provisions with the requirements of the MSME sector.
The amendments aim to reduce payment-related constraints, make dispute resolution more time-bound, and simplify compliance.
The broader objective is to facilitate the growth, development, and competitiveness of the MSME sector.

national_news.title: Implementation of Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Operational Guidelines
bullets: The Government of India has released the Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Operational guidelines to address anemia through a 7X7X7 strategy.
The guidelines focus on Testing, Treatment, Tracking, and Dietary Diversification to accelerate anemia reduction.
The 7X7X7 framework aims to achieve a significant reduction in anemia prevalence across the country.

national_news.title: Container Manufacturing Assistance Scheme Launched to Boost India's Maritime Capabilities
bullets: The Container Manufacturing Assistance Scheme (CMAS) has been launched with a ₹10,000 crore outlay to promote manufacturing, investment, and technology development in the container ecosystem.
The initiative aims to strengthen India's maritime capabilities, generate employment, and support the country's long-term trade competitiveness.
The scheme is part of broader reforms in shipping, ports, and logistics to boost India's trade and manufacturing ambitions.

national_news.title: Objective of Ayush Grid: Digitizing Service Delivery and Strengthening Governance
bullets: Ayush Grid aims to digitize service delivery and strengthen transparency, efficiency, and governance across healthcare, research, education, drug administration, capacity building, and medicinal plants.
The Ayush Grid project is compliant with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) and has developed the Ayush Hospital Management Information System (AHMIS).
The Ministry of Ayush has launched the Ayush Grid project as a comprehensive IT backbone for the Ayush sector.

national_news.title: DPIIT, MSME Ministry sign MoU to propel India's GI products into global markets
bullets: The MoU aims to accelerate the commercialisation and quality enhancement of India's Geographical Indications (GI) products.
The partnership between DPIIT and MSME Ministry aims to promote India's GI products globally.
The MoU was signed on August 5 at Vanijya Bhawan in New Delhi.

national_news.title: Top 5 Indian States Leading in EV Registrations and Adoption Rates
bullets: India has seen a rapid increase in demand for electric vehicles (EVs).
The top 5 states in EV registrations and adoption rates in India have been identified.
The list of highest-selling EV OEMs in the electric car category has also been revealed.

national_news.title: MoHUA holds national conference on affordable housing; Rajiv Gauba calls for land and urban planning reforms
bullets: MoHUA organised a National Conference on Affordable Housing Reforms - 'Reimagining Affordable Housing: From Scheme to Sustainable Ecosystem'
Rajiv Gauba called for land and urban planning reforms during the conference
The conference aimed to reimagine affordable housing as a sustainable ecosystem

national_news.title: Will UPI Transactions Attract Charges? Here's What the New Law Says
bullets: The new law may introduce charges for UPI transactions, affecting users.
The exact details of the new law and its implications are yet to be clarified.
This development may impact the usage and adoption of UPI payments in India.

national_news.title: National Green Hydrogen Mission Advances Green Hydrogen Adoption in Petroleum and Refining Sector
bullets: The Government of India is implementing the National Green Hydrogen Mission (NGHM) to make India a global hub for green hydrogen production, usage, and export.
Under the SIGHT (Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition) Mode - 2B scheme of the NGHM, 30 Kilo Tonnes Per Annum (KTPA) green hydrogen production capacity has been awarded.
The NGHM aims to promote the adoption of green hydrogen in the petroleum and refining sector.

national_news.title: Government Promotes Sustainable Growth of Data Centres through Energy-Efficient and Clean Energy Measures
bullets: The government is promoting sustainable growth of data centres through energy-efficient and clean energy measures.
Data centres are an integral component of the overall Digital India Infrastructure ecosystem.
The data centre industry in India has been growing at a steady pace, driven by increasing demand for data centre infrastructure.

national_news.title: Launch of Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessel
bullets: The Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessel (NGOPV) was launched at M/s GRSE, Kolkata.
The vessel, Yard 3037 (Shruti), was launched by Mrs Manika Sadhu in the presence of Vice Admiral Sanjay Sadhu.
The event reflected the rich traditions and ethos of the Indian Navy.

national_news.title: Vice-President flags off 'Har Ghar Tiranga Bike Rally 2026' in Delhi
bullets: Vice-President C P Radhakrishnan flagged off the 'Har Ghar Tiranga Bike Rally 2026' from Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.
The rally is part of the ongoing Har Ghar Tiranga 2026 campaign dedicated to the National Song Vande Mataram.
Union Cabinet Ministers and Ministers of State were also present at the event.

national_news.title: Fact Check Unit in PIB mitigates fake news related to govt
bullets: Fact Check Unit in PIB has been established to counter fake news related to the government.
The unit aims to verify the authenticity of news and information before it spreads.
This initiative is a step towards promoting transparency and accountability in governance.

national_news.title: Govt outlines initiatives on credible info dissemination in LS
bullets: Government outlines initiatives on credible information dissemination in the Lok Sabha.
Details of the initiatives are not specified in the provided content.
This news is relevant to the topic of media and information dissemination in India.

national_news.title: India and Namibia to Move Beyond Raw-Material-Based Trade
bullets: The Fourth Session of the India-Namibia Joint Trade Committee (JTC) concluded in New Delhi.
Both countries agreed to move beyond a raw-material-based composition in bilateral trade.
The agreed minutes of the Session were signed by the two Co-Chairs.

national_news.title: Dr Bhooma VG selected for Vice-Chancellor post at Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute in Mauritius
bullets: Dr Bhooma VG (IRPS (Retd)) has been selected for the post of Vice-Chancellor at the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Public Service and Innovation (AIPSI) of Mauritius.
AIPSI was jointly inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the Prime Minister of Mauritius, Navinchandra Ramgoolam, in March 2025.
The Institute is being developed as a premier training agency and a centre of excellence for the African region.

national_news.title: IMD forecasts heavy rainfall over several parts of the country for next two to three days
bullets: IMD has issued orange alert for heavy to very heavy rainfall over East Rajasthan, Madhya Maharashtra, Odisha, Jharkhand, and Gangetic West Bengal.

Heavy rainfall predicted over North eastern parts of the country, Sikkim, Sub Himalayan West Bengal, Chhattisgarh, West Madhya Pradesh, West Rajasthan, Gujarat, Konkan, Goa, Punjab, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, and Andaman and Nicobar Islands for the next two to three days.
States like Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, and Rajasthan are also expected to receive heavy rainfall.

national_news.title: RBI Governor asks banks to adopt AI with caution for accountability and customer trust
bullets: RBI Governor emphasized the need for Indian banks to adopt AI with a focus on innovation, accountability, and customer trust.
The Governor highlighted potential risks associated with AI adoption, including opaque models, algorithmic bias, and data privacy concerns.
The RBI Governor urged banks to exercise caution and consider these risks while implementing AI-driven solutions.

national_news.title: IT collection over eight lakh crore so far; 23.09% higher than last fiscal same period
bullets: Income Tax Department collected over 8.11 lakh crore rupees net direct tax for the financial year 2026-27 so far.
The collection includes corporate tax of over 2.70 lakh crore rupees and non-corporate tax of 5.07 lakh crore rupees.
The department has also issued refunds of over one lakh 43 thousand crore rupees.

national_news.title: India and Namibia to Move Beyond Raw-Material-Based Trade Composition
bullets: The Fourth Session of the India-Namibia Joint Trade Committee (JTC) concluded in New Delhi.
Both sides agreed to move bilateral trade beyond a raw-material-based composition towards value addition.
The agreed minutes of the Session were signed by the two Co-Chairs.

national_news.title: Dr Bhooma VG selected as Vice-Chancellor at Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute in Mauritius
bullets: Dr Bhooma VG (IRPS Retd) has been selected for the post of Vice-Chancellor at the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Public Service and Innovation (AIPSI) of Mauritius.
AIPSI was jointly inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the Prime Minister of Mauritius in March 2025.
The Institute is being developed as a premier training agency and a centre of excellence for the African region.

national_news.title: Rail Coach Factory Kapurthala rolls out first rake of 19 LHB coaches for Bangladesh Railways
bullets: The rake comprises 03 AC Sleeper Cars, 03 AC Chair Cars, 11 Non-AC Chair Cars and 02 Power Cars.
The coaches have been specially customised to meet the operational and passenger requirements of Bangladesh Railway.
The seating arrangement incorporates specially designed reclining seats for passenger comfort.

national_news.title: India reaffirms commitment to elephant conservation on World Elephant Day
bullets: India has 33 Elephant Reserves across 14 States.
The country has 150 scientifically validated elephant corridors.
India is strengthening elephant conservation through advanced population monitoring and measures to mitigate human-elephant conflict.

national_news.title: Indian fencers win two gold, three silver and four bronze medals at Commonwealth Championship
bullets: Indian fencers secured 17 medals on the opening day of the Commonwealth Fencing Championship in Lagos, Nigeria.
Karan Singh and Sherjin Shanthimol clinched gold medals for India in the senior men's events.
The Indian team added to the country's tally, showcasing their impressive medal-winning run.

national_news.title: Supreme Court asks 19 States and UTs to consider declaring cancer a notifiable disease
bullets: Supreme Court directed 19 remaining States and Union Territories to consider declaring cancer a notifiable disease.
17 out of 36 States and Union Territories have already notified cancer as a notifiable disease.
The move aims to facilitate early detection and ensure proper care of patients.

national_news.title: IMD forecasts heavy rainfall over several parts of the country
bullets: IMD issued orange alert for heavy to very heavy rainfall over East Rajasthan, Madhya Maharashtra, Odisha, Jharkhand, and Gangetic West Bengal.

Heavy rainfall predicted over North eastern parts of the country, Sikkim, Sub Himalayan West Bengal, Chhattisgarh, West Madhya Pradesh, West Rajasthan, Gujarat, Konkan, Goa, Punjab, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, and Andaman and Nicobar Islands for the next two to three days.
States like Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, and Rajasthan are also expected to receive heavy rainfall.

national_news.title: Amit Shah to move Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026 in Rajya Sabha
bullets: The Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill seeks to change the name of the state of Kerala to Keralam in the First Schedule of the Constitution.
A resolution in this regard was passed by the Kerala Legislative Assembly in June 2024.
The Bill will be considered and passed in Rajya Sabha today.

national_news.title: PM Modi releases former President Ram Nath Kovind's autobiography in New Delhi
bullets: Former President Ram Nath Kovind's autobiography titled 'Triumph of the Indian Republic: My Life, My Struggles' was released by PM Modi in New Delhi.
The autobiography offers a deeply personal account of Mr Kovind's life journey, tracing his experiences, struggles, and achievements from his early years to his public life.
The book provides insights into the values, experiences, and circumstances that shaped Mr Kovind's journey and public service.

national_news.title: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal highlights GeM’s role in transparent public procurement
bullets: GeM ensures procurement of the right product of the right quality, at the right price and at the right time.
The platform promotes transparency, competitiveness, and good governance in public procurement.
It has replaced non-transparent and misused public procurement practices prior to its introduction.

national_news.title: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal highlights GeM's role in transparent public procurement
bullets: GeM (Government e-Marketplace) ensures procurement of the right product of the right quality, at the right price and at the right time.
Prior to GeM, public money was being misused, procurement was non-transparent and lacked good governance.
GeM has introduced a public procurement e-commerce platform, promoting transparency and competitiveness.

national_news.title: India secures two medals at World Athletics U20 Championships in US
bullets: Basant Kumar Meghwal won silver in men's high jump with a personal best clearance of 2.21 metres.
Shahnavaz Khan claimed bronze in men's long jump with a best effort of 7.84 metres.
This is the first time Indians have won medals in high jump and long jump at the championships.

national_news.title: Hockey World Cup to be played in new format; quarterfinal stage scrapped
bullets: The FIH Hockey Men's and Women's World Cup 2026 will feature a revamped competition structure.
The traditional quarterfinal stage has been scrapped, and the top two teams from each crossover pool will advance directly to the semi-finals.
The tournament will be jointly hosted by Belgium and the Netherlands from August 15 to 30.

national_news.title: India, Israel discuss ways to deepen development partnership through MASHAV
bullets: India and Israel discussed cooperation in Centres of Excellence in agriculture, capacity building in agriculture and water management.
The two sides also exchanged views on further strengthening the partnership through MASHAV.
MASHAV, Israel's Agency for International Development Cooperation, was established to share Israel's expertise with other countries.

national_news.title: Indian Navy-US Navy EOD Exercise 2026 commences at Southern Naval Command
bullets: The exercise aims to enhance interoperability and strengthen professional cooperation between the specialist diving and EOD teams of the two navies.
The 5-day exercise will comprise Subject Matter Expert Exchanges, cross-training, equipment demonstrations, and scenario-based practical exercises.
The programme will facilitate the exchange of contemporary EOD methodologies, emerging technologies, and best practices.

national_news.title: Nation pays homage to revolutionary freedom fighter Khudiram Bose on 119th martyrdom day
bullets: Khudiram Bose was the first Indian revolutionary in Bengal to be executed by the British in 1908.
He joined India's freedom movement at a young age and became one of the youngest martyrs of the anti-British struggle.
Various programs have been organised across the country to remember the young revolutionary and pay tribute to his supreme sacrifice.

national_news.title: India wins 17 medals, including 4 gold, on opening day of U-23 Commonwealth Fencing Championship
bullets: India secured 4 gold, 4 silver and 9 bronze medals at the championship.
Indian fencers reached the podium in all 6 individual events across the Sabre, Foil and Epee disciplines.
Nikhil Wagh won the gold medal in the men's Sabre event.

national_news.title: Government notifies 11 more International Ports for e-visa holders
bullets: 11 more International Ports have been notified for e-visa holders to enter India.
The notification includes 9 land ports and 2 airports, including Bhopal and Tirupati airports.
India processes approximately 95 per cent of e-visa applications in less than 72 hours.

national_news.title: Parliament passes Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026
bullets: The Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, was passed by the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha after discussion.
As it is a Money Bill, the Rajya Sabha can only make recommendations on its provisions and return it to the Lok Sabha.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman replied to the discussion on the Bill in the Rajya Sabha.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Inspects Proposed Medical College Site in Gopalganj, Gives Directions
bullets: Bihar CM inspected the proposed site for Maa Thawe Medical College and Hospital in Gopalganj.
The CM performed puja and aradhana at Thawe Temple, praying for the state's prosperity, peace, and happiness.
The CM's visit is aimed at boosting development and infrastructure in the region.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Governor's Speech in Joint Session of Bihar Vidhan Mandal
bullets: Speeches were given by the Honourable Governor of Bihar during joint sessions of Bihar Vidhan Mandal from 2023 to 2026.
Bihar is an entirely land–locked state located in the eastern part of the country.
The state has been without a sea outlet for almost fifteen years.

bullets: 9 people lost their lives in lightning strikes in 3 districts of Bihar.
The Chief Minister expressed deep condolences and shock over the incident.
The CM emphasized the importance of ensuring timely benefits of government schemes to the last person through the state-level cooperation program.

bullets: 9 people lost their lives due to lightning strikes in 3 districts of Bihar.
The Chief Minister expressed deep condolences and grief over the incident.
The government aims to ensure timely benefits of government schemes and justice reaches the last person through the state-level cooperation program.
